title: Ops eyeball scrub — today listing
content:
Sheet: Ops eyeball scrub (one-off tracker)

Columns: ID, Item, Owner, Priority, ETA, Status, Quick note

1, APAC fallback route check, Lena Zhou, P0, 2029-12-05, needs verification, Partial: missing region endpoints for SIN, HKG; see slack thread #apac-fallback
2, Dedicated pool oversubscribe check, Ethan Cole, P1, 2029-12-07, gathering numbers, estimate shows uneven burst behavior for 2 customers
3, Canary fallback list refresh, Priya Nair, P2, 2029-12-06, in progress, remove deprecated model variants and add regional fallbacks
4, Emergency contact shortlist, Lena Zhou, P1, 2029-12-06, todo, build 3-line contact per region (oncall -> backup -> infra tie-in)
5, Quick cost delta calc (embeddings routing), Mariana Ortiz, P2, 2029-12-06, draft, approx numbers below

Ad-hoc calc (rough):
- Baseline dedicated reserved hours (this cluster): 2400 h/month
- Observed burst extra consumption (sample week): +12% -> projected extra = 2400 * 0.12 = 288 h/month
- Unit cost assumption (placeholder): $0.50 / reserved-hour -> incremental = 288 * 0.5 = $144/month (approx)
- Note: if we shift 40% of burst to hosted fallback with queued rate, net delta ~ -$60/month but increases latency TAT on heavy tails

Quick actions for standup (TODAY):
- Mariana: confirm with infra whether per-customer burst policy can be toggled by EOD 12/06
- Ethan: pull last 7 days of burst logs (IDs + top 5 callers) and drop CSV into this sheet
- Lena: assemble regional 3-line contacts and post to #ops-handovers; highlight APAC gaps
- Priya: refresh canary rotation (remove model variants flagged in JIRA-5241) and add test prompts for coverage checks

Notes to self / rough heuristics:
- This is an eyeball-level scan: prioritize P0/P1 items only for the morning cadence.
- Don’t convert to policy here — use as input for a short follow-up doc if we see >2% burn impact or >1 region missing critical fallback.
- Keep rollup to 1 page for exec summary: 3 bullets (gap, risk, immediate ask).

References / quick links:
- JIRA-5241 (routing regressions)
- confluence://ops/coverage-cookbook (handbook)
- slack:#ops-handovers (handoff channel)

Free-form notes:
- 12:15 AM check: spike of 3 calls showing long tail; likely customer X running a nightly job against deprecated variant. Put a sticky note to contact SE.
- If infra says no per-customer toggle, prepare fallback plan: automatically reroute >95th percentile requests to a cheaper compatible variant with warm KV caching.

This sheet is intentionally lightweight — quick triage output, not final artifact.
